description: Map ClinVar pathogenic TANC2 variants onto the protein domain architecture and scan for PP1-docking motifs
code:
import requests, re, time, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

seq=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9HCD6.json",timeout=120).json()["sequence"]["value"]
print("len",len(seq),"| C-terminal 12 aa:",seq[-12:])
# PP1-docking RVxF motif consensus [RK]-x(0,1)-[VI]-x-[FW]
hits=[(m.start()+1,m.group()) for m in re.finditer(r'(?=([RK].{0,1}[VI].[FW]))',seq) for m in [m]]
hits=[(m.start()+1,m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(r'(?=([RK].{0,1}[VI].[FW]))',seq)]
print("RVxF-like motifs: n=%d"%len(hits), hits[:15])

eut="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def get(u,p,t=6):
    for _ in range(t):
        r=requests.get(u,params=p,timeout=120)
        try: return r.json()
        except Exception: time.sleep(3)
    raise RuntimeError
ids=get(eut+"esearch.fcgi",{"db":"clinvar","term":"TANC2[gene]","retmax":2000,"retmode":"json"})["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    res=get(eut+"esummary.fcgi",{"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+200]),"retmode":"json"}).get("result",{})
    for uid in res.get("uids",[]):
        x=res[uid]; cls=x.get("germline_classification",{}).get("description","")
        vs=(x.get("variation_set") or [{}])[0]
        recs.append({"name":vs.get("variation_name",""),"type":vs.get("variant_type",""),"cls":cls})
    time.sleep(0.8)
cv=pd.DataFrame(recs)
print("\nClinVar records:",len(cv))
def paa(n):
    m=re.search(r'p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)',n)
    return int(m.group(2)) if m else None
cv["aa"]=cv.name.map(paa)
cv["PLP"]=cv.cls.str.contains("athogenic") & ~cv.cls.str.contains("Conflicting")
def kind(r):
    n=r["name"]
    if "Ter" in n or "fs" in n or "*" in n: return "truncating"
    if r["type"]=="single nucleotide variant" and "p." in n: return "missense"
    return "other"
cv["kind"]=cv.apply(kind,axis=1)
plp=cv[cv.PLP & cv.aa.notna()]
print(plp.kind.value_counts().to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.6))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1,-0.12),1990,0.24,color="#dfe6e9",ec="k",lw=.5))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((846,-0.18),1227-846,0.36,color="#2980b9",alpha=.85,label="ANK repeats (846-1227)"))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1244,-0.18),1358-1244,0.36,color="#27ae60",alpha=.85,label="TPR repeats (1244-1358)"))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1978,-0.22),12,0.44,color="#8e44ad",label="PDZ-binding motif (C-term)"))
for d in [(1,85),(129,149),(396,442),(1372,1401),(1430,1586),(1692,1718),(1783,1803),(1821,1843),(1968,1990)]:
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((d[0],-0.05),d[1]-d[0],0.10,color="#b2bec3"))
tr=plp[plp.kind=="truncating"].aa.values; ms=plp[plp.kind=="missense"].aa.values
ax.scatter(tr,[0.33]*len(tr),marker="v",s=55,color="#c0392b",zorder=5,label="P/LP truncating (n=%d)"%len(tr))
ax.scatter(ms,[-0.33]*len(ms),marker="o",s=45,color="#e67e22",zorder=5,label="P/LP missense (n=%d)"%len(ms))
ax.axvline(1406,ls="--",color="k",lw=1.2)
ax.text(1406,0.50,"NMD-escape boundary\n(last coding exon)",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,2060); ax.set_ylim(-0.6,0.62); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("TANC2 protein position (UniProt Q9HCD6, 1990 aa)")
ax.set_title("TANC2 domain architecture and ClinVar pathogenic variants",fontsize=12)
ax.legend(loc="lower center",ncol=3,fontsize=8,frameon=False,bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,-0.55))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
